# gfxdev.org

> Hardware-close graphics engineering and self-hostable AI workflows that help teams make limited specialist expertise go further and identify issues earlier.

gfxdev.org covers rendering research, engine technology, authorized reverse engineering, graphics backports, stack traceability, and pipeline QA. Workflows connect existing open-source and commercial tools to evidence engineers can review. Engineers retain control of protected actions and release decisions. Workflows are fully self-hostable without cloud agent services.

The demo is planned for Q1 2027. Contact: info@gfxdev.org.

## Main Pages

- [Graphics engineering and AI workflows](https://www.gfxdev.org/): Services, stack coverage, engineering workflow, and contact information.
- [Product story](https://www.gfxdev.org/pitch/): Mission, specialist capacity constraints, the product, and a game modernization journey.

## Detailed Topics

- [Graphics stack coverage](https://www.gfxdev.org/#platforms): Investigation, engine patterns, backports, traceability, QA, and agentic execution with guardrails.
- [Engineering workflow](https://www.gfxdev.org/#experience): Existing toolchain integration, self-hosting, research grounding, and engineering review.
- [Game modernization](https://www.gfxdev.org/pitch/#journey): Recover original behavior, port to a modern platform, explore enhancements, and validate against agreed requirements.
